whenToUse: Screens where questions and answers continue, such as AI assistants or support.
People reread earlier messages and ask follow-ups.
whenNotToUse: Searches asked once and done (use a search results screen).
Producing long documents (use an editor screen).
Replacing every feature of a messenger used by many people at once.
accessibility: The conversation list announces new messages with role=log and aria-live.
Each bubble has screen reader text saying who spoke, you or the assistant.
Scrolling isn't hijacked while people read further up.
The conversation area has a tabIndex so it scrolls with the keyboard.
